title: Machine Catalog Convergence for Calculator + Shop Profiles
brief: Unify the 920-machine enriched corpus into a configuration-aware machine-package model that powers the calculator machine-selection module, preserves only legal controller/spindle/coolant/capability combinations, persists user-owned shop machine profiles for downstream reuse, and extends the calculator with PRISM mode recommendations.

knowledge_sources.physics_constants: src/physics/constants.ts — CANONICAL_KIENZLE (kc1.1, mc), CANONICAL_TAYLOR (C, n), CANONICAL_MATERIAL_DB
knowledge_sources.formulas: FormulaRegistry — Kienzle Fc=kc1.1*ap*fz^(1-mc), Taylor VT^n=C, P=T*rpm/9549

sessions.title: Data Audit and Truth Schema
sessions.intent: System has definitive audit of all 920 machines' field completeness and owns a single CanonicalMachinePackage type unifying the 3 colliding models.

measurable_criteria: Audit covers 100% of machine JSON files (0 unparsed)
CanonicalMachinePackage type compiles with zero TS errors
Field completeness report generated with exact percentages per layer

abort_criteria: Audit script cannot parse >10% of JSON files
CanonicalMachinePackage type has >5 unresolvable conflicts with existing Machine interfaces
Session exceeds 90K context without completing U-MCAT02

sessions.title: Truth Hierarchy + Taxonomy
sessions.intent: Machines load with deterministic layer priority and all type strings are normalized to a closed taxonomy enum.

measurable_criteria: MachineLayerMerger passes all unit tests with zero data loss
Taxonomy normalizer classifies >95% of machines to non-OTHER types
Both engines have >90% line coverage in tests

abort_criteria: Merge produces data loss on any existing machine record
>5% of machines classified as OTHER
Layer merge creates duplicate canonical IDs

sessions.title: Data Remediation Sprint
sessions.intent: Controller completeness rises from ~0.5% to >60%, spindle+coolant completeness to >50%. Unblocks safety hooks.

measurable_criteria: Controller completeness >= 60% (from ~0.5%)
Spindle completeness >= 50%
Coolant completeness >= 40%
Zero JSON parse errors in any modified file

abort_criteria: Backfill script corrupts any JSON file (validate before+after)
Any spindle value outside physical limits (max_rpm > 100000, power > 200kW)
Controller brand cannot be resolved for >40% of machines

rollback.U-MCAT05: Restore ENHANCED JSON from pre-backfill backup
rollback.U-MCAT06: Restore ENHANCED JSON from pre-backfill backup

sessions.title: Registry Convergence + Safety Hooks
sessions.intent: Exactly ONE MachineRegistry returns CanonicalMachinePackage. 5 safety hooks block bad machine data from propagating to calculators.

measurable_criteria: MachineRegistry v2 returns CanonicalMachinePackage from getPackage()
All 5 safety hooks registered and passing tests
Backward compatibility: dataDispatcher machine_get/search returns equivalent results
Zero new TypeScript compilation errors
Hooks block zero-RPM and null-power machines

abort_criteria: Any existing dataDispatcher machine_get/machine_search call returns different results
Hooks block >20% of existing valid calculator calls
Registry load time exceeds 2 seconds for 920 machines

rollback.U-MCAT07: git checkout MachineRegistry.ts and dataDispatcher.ts; delete compat shim
rollback.U-MCAT08: Remove hook registration entries; delete MachineValidationHooks.ts

sessions.title: MachinePackageGeneratorEngine
sessions.intent: A single engine generates complete, validated CanonicalMachinePackage from any combination of registry data + user overrides + shop profile.

measurable_criteria: Engine generates valid packages for all 10 test machines
Completeness scoring: known-complete machines >90%, sparse <50%
All 30+ tests pass with >85% line coverage
Physics validation: power/torque/rpm relationships consistent within 5%

abort_criteria: Engine generates physically impossible values (RPM*torque/9549 differs from power by >10%)
<80% line coverage on the engine
Package generation exceeds 200ms per machine

sessions.title: Calculator Dual-Path Migration
sessions.intent: All calculator operations resolve machine packages first (heuristic fallback). Speed/feed uses real spindle limits, not hardcoded defaults.

measurable_criteria: All 15 existing calculator tests pass (zero regressions)
Package path produces machine-constrained results for 6 calculator actions
Heuristic fallback works when no machine identifier provided
Machine-aware speed/feed caps at spindle limits (tested with Haas VF-2: 8100 RPM)
RPM clamp: min(calculated, machine.max_rpm) verified
Feed clamp: min(calculated, machine.max_feed) verified

abort_criteria: Any of the 15 existing calculator tests fail
Machine-constrained speed/feed produces values outside safe cutting parameter ranges
Dual-path overhead exceeds 50ms per calculator call

rollback.U-MCAT11: git checkout calcDispatcher.ts and AdvancedCalculations.ts; delete test file
rollback.U-MCAT12: Delete MachineAwareSpeedFeed.ts and test; revert index.ts

sessions.title: Calculator Completion + Dispatcher Actions
sessions.intent: Cost calculations derive machine rates from packages. 3 new dispatcher actions (machine_package_get/generate/validate) are live.

measurable_criteria: Cost calculator uses derived machine rates when package available
3 new dispatcher actions return correct responses
Machine rate derivation: $0.50-$15.00/min range validated
All new + existing tests pass

abort_criteria: Derived rates outside $0.50-$15.00/min range
New actions break existing dataDispatcher routing
Cost calculations regress vs baseline

sessions.title: Downstream Reuse — Chain A (CAM + Post)
sessions.intent: CAM strategy recommendations and post-processor generation both consume CanonicalMachinePackage for machine-specific results.

measurable_criteria: CAM strategy returns machine-appropriate strategies (3-axis machine gets 3+2 only, not sim-5)
Post-processor generation uses actual controller specs from package
Both integrations pass new + existing tests

abort_criteria: Existing CAM strategy tests fail
Post-processor output produces invalid G-code for known controllers
Machine package resolution adds >100ms to CAM/Post calls

sessions.title: Downstream Reuse — Chain B + PRISM Mode
sessions.intent: Shop profiles bind to machine packages. PRISM mode surfaces machine intelligence proactively. Frontend audit identifies all 31 touchpoints.

measurable_criteria: Shop profiles bind to machine packages with CRUD operations
PRISM mode recommends ranked machines for job planning
Frontend audit identifies all 31 machine touchpoints with migration paths
Shop profile validation: rejects binding to non-existent machine IDs

abort_criteria: Shop profile storage corrupts existing state files
Intelligence recommendations produce obviously wrong machine selections
Frontend audit finds >40 touchpoints (scope creep risk)

sessions.title: Validation and Hardening
sessions.intent: E2E tests, performance benchmarks, regression guard, complete documentation. Milestone closeable.

measurable_criteria: All E2E tests pass (happy path + fallbacks + safety blocks)
Performance: package gen <50ms, search <20ms, hooks <5ms each
Test coverage across all MCAT files >85%
Documentation complete: ADR, API guide, completion report
Zero open defects
exit_gate.svi_note: Total SVI delta from S1 baseline must be >= 0.30

abort_criteria: Any E2E test exposes data flow break not caught by unit tests
Package generation >200ms (O(n^2) in merger)
Final omega score < 0.85

exit_conditions: The calculator machine-selection module resolves every supported machine through a canonical machine-package model
Controller, spindle, coolant, and capability options are filtered by published availability — impossible combinations do not render
User-owned shop machine profiles can be saved as overlays on canonical machine packages
Print to CNC and Program Release can consume the same machine package used by the calculator
The calculator can derive machine-legal, inventory-aware setup recommendations from the saved machine profile
Budget, standard, and premium purchase recommendations ranked by compatibility, cutting-data confidence, ROI, and payback
Remaining brand or package ambiguities are explicit, ranked, and repairable through audit and remediation flows
14 blocking safety hooks prevent bad machine data from producing dangerous cutting parameters
All 22 units pass 4-loop quality gate (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP)
Final omega score >= 0.85 (formula: 0.25R + 0.20C + 0.15P + 0.30S + 0.10L, S >= 0.70 hard constraint)
